_howto: Creator Library manifest. Add items to the arrays below, then commit + push (the partner page fetches this file — no code changes needed). Schemas — videos: {title, desc, url, thumb, added}. downloads: {title, desc, url, type, size, added}. copy: {group, title, text, added} where group is one of hooks|captions|ctas|scripts. clipper_videos (watch-only example edits, NOT downloadable): {title, src (mp4 path in the repo, e.g. clippers/clip-example-1.mp4), added}. clipper_material (downloadable brand PNGs — opaque cards or transparent overlays — each previewed whole on its 'bg' letterbox; opaque cards use a light bg, a transparent overlay can force a contrasting one, auto-detected from a 'light'/'dark' name): {title, url, type, size, added, bg?}. 'added' is a YYYY-MM-DD date and drives the NEW badge for 14 days.
